assumptions: Fixed Q, R and initial settings declared before evaluation; no final-run covariance fitting. Deterministic simulator plus independent additive sensor noise; Q is a robustness assumption, not injected physical process noise. NIS/NEES therefore diagnose misspecification and are not claimed chi-square calibrated here. NEES dimension=2; NIS dimension=current measurement count. Temporal samples are correlated. Coverage is pointwise empirical coverage; convergence means both errors stay <=0.05 m through run end. Three fixed seeds characterize examples, not population guarantees. Numerical failures abort this script.
